thread_text:
alex: Quick sync after the RFC 1: we need a minimal contract for envelopes that supports cheap runtime emission and forensics. Two knobs: keep per-request fingerprint + segments, or send full token events. leaning compact segments.
noor: compact segments sound right. runtime emits: fp, tenant, model, total_tokens, segments=[{s:0,e:12,variant:v1}], schema_v. sample: `fp:sha256:... model:rwkv-16b tokens:128 segments:[(0-63,v1),(64-127,v2)]`
diego: Ops note: if segments are omitted treat as single-segment of entire request. also we should include perf_tier when known so billing can pick price units without rehydration.
alex: For reconciliation we will: provisional charges (window close) -> finalizer emits ledger event with attribution_rev and ledger_id. any change after final emits reconciliation_delta referencing ledger_id + fps.
noor: Retention proposal: envelopes hot for 7d, segment-index for 30d, traces for 90d cold. Backfill by ops only.
diego: Failure modes: producer backpressure -> emit `partial:true` & minimal sketch (fp,tokens). ingest must mark low confidence and not finalize billing without ops review.
ops-bot: Created MET-1004: envelope-contract-spike (assignee alex).
